page.overview:
Who is Amazoness Paladin?

Amazoness Paladin, known as Amazoness Holy Warrior in the Japanese version, is the Duel Monster version of the card of the same name.

Amazoness Paladin appears briefly in a flashback when Tania explains how she and other denizens of her dimension unexpectedly switched dimensions in the Duel Monsters Spirit World.

In Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008, she is found at the colosseum in the Grace world. Here the player can face her using Structure Decks. If they defeat her using all 13, they unlock Bastion Misawa.

Amazoness Paladin also appears in Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2009: Stardust Accelerator as an opponent.
